flowchart TD
  subgraph PKG["Paquet"]
    A["lib/axlsx.rb"] --> B["lib/axlsx/package.rb"]
    B --> C["lib/axlsx/workbook/workbook.rb"]
    B --> D["lib/axlsx/util/buffered_zip_output_stream.rb"]
    B --> L["lib/schema/sml.xsd"]
  end
  subgraph SHEET["Feuilles"]
    C --> E["lib/axlsx/workbook/worksheet/worksheet.rb"]
    E --> F["lib/axlsx/workbook/worksheet/row.rb"]
    F --> G["lib/axlsx/workbook/worksheet/cell.rb"]
    G --> H["lib/axlsx/workbook/worksheet/cell_serializer.rb"]
    C --> I["lib/axlsx/stylesheet/styles.rb"]
  end
  subgraph DRAW["Graphiques"]
    E --> J["lib/axlsx/workbook/worksheet/worksheet_drawing.rb"]
    J --> K["lib/axlsx/drawing/chart.rb"]

explication: Un Package contient le classeur, ses feuilles, lignes et cellules, ainsi que les styles et les graphiques via drawing. A la serialisation, le paquet valide le XML contre les schemas xsd puis ecrit l'archive zip.
source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: A Package contains the workbook, its sheets, rows and cells, as well as the styles and charts via drawing. On serialization, the package validates the XML against the xsd schemas then writes the zip archive.
